verdict.rationale: Jules is a task-delegation agent at its core. Per the docs, users submit a task, review and approve a generated plan, and Jules works in a cloud VM, notifies on completion, and opens a PR. Tasks can also be assigned via a GitHub 'jules' label or the API. Hands-on users confirm delegating tasks and coming back to reviewable PRs. Missing for 10: reliable completion on complex tasks, since users report loops with no stop button, timeouts, and confusion in monorepos.
